Three women killed by speeding truck in Morena after festival

Three women returning from a Krishna Janmashtami festival in Morena were killed when a speeding truck struck them. The incident occurred as the women were leaving a temple. Police have arrested the truck driver and initiated an investigation into the accident. The accident turned a festive occasion into mourning.
